corrections.reason: Canonical Ge'ez Gospel of John 1:10 reads 'ወዓለምኒ ቦቱ ኮነ' (and the world was made through Him). In the column image, the shortened right leg of 7th-order 'ቦ' is visible.
Completes the word 'ቃል' split across lines 39-40 ('ነበረ ከመ ቃል እንዲል'). The 6th-order 'ል' top loop is clearly visible in the image.
